extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) GUI desktop management — desktop is the working area with icons. Wallpaper is the background picture. Shortcut is a quick link (has a small arrow) to open files/programs without searching. Taskbar at the bottom shows open programs. Right-click opens context menu (Copy, Paste, Rename, Delete). Customise = change how desktop looks (wallpaper, icon size, arrange icons). (2) Word processor tools — Find and Replace: find a word and swap it with another. Spell Check: finds spelling mistakes and suggests corrections (red underline). Thesaurus: gives synonyms (similar meaning words) and antonyms (opposite meaning words). Word Count: counts words, characters, paragraphs. (3) Formatting in Word — alignment: Left (text starts from left), Center (text centered), Right (text ends at right), Justify (even on both sides). Line spacing: space between lines (single, 1.5, double). Bullets: dots before each item in a list. Numbering: numbers before each item. (4) Changing text case and font — font type = design of letters. Arial = sans-serif (no decorative strokes, clean/modern). Times New Roman = serif (tiny lines at ends, formal/traditional). Text case: UPPERCASE (ALL CAPITALS), lowercase (all small), Title Case (First Letter Of Each Word), Sentence case (First letter of sentence only). Shortcuts: Ctrl+B = bold, Ctrl+I = italic, Ctrl+U = underline, Ctrl+Z = undo. Misconceptions: 'a shortcut is the actual file' (a shortcut is a LINK to the file, not the file itself — it has a small arrow and if you delete the shortcut, the original file is still safe), 'spell check finds all mistakes' (spell check finds SPELLING mistakes, not grammar mistakes — a correctly spelled word used wrongly will not be flagged), 'left align and justify are the same' (left align starts text from the left but the right side is uneven, justify makes BOTH sides even), 'Arial and Times New Roman are the same font' (Arial is sans-serif with no decorative lines, Times New Roman is serif with tiny lines at letter ends — they look different), 'UPPERCASE and Title Case are the same' (UPPERCASE makes ALL letters capital, Title Case makes only the FIRST letter of each word capital — they are different). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function WordFormattingGame), NOT export default. Export interface WordFormattingGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
